_readme: GOLDEN SET — the ground truth your hit-rate is measured against.
Each entry says: for this question, WHICH page(s) actually contain the
answer. Retrieval is 'correct' if a chunk from one of those pages shows
Answers are keyed on filename + page, NOT chunk id, because chunk ids
(doc_id_N) are regenerated every time you re-upload a PDF. Filename +
'failure_kind' is YOUR label, filled in after you inspect the trace:
retrieval  = the right page never made the top k -> fix retrieval
generation = right page WAS retrieved, answer still wrong -> fix the
prompt, the chunk size, or the model
ok         = works fine, kept as a regression guard
'category' groups questions by WHY they are hard. This is what lets you
say 'hybrid fixed the exact_term questions and did nothing for the
vague_phrasing ones' — which is the 'what did your change NOT fix?'

questions.question: What does BILL-RESTOCK mean?
questions.note: Dense search confuses BILL-RESTOCK / BILL-ONLY / RESTOCK-ONLY because they embed almost identically. BM25 should nail it on the literal token.

questions.question: Which order types are counted as revenue?
questions.note: Answer is 'only BILL-ONLY and BILL-RESTOCK; RESTOCK-ONLY excluded'. Needs the exact order-type tokens.

questions.question: What is the sNumber field on an Order?
questions.note: camelCase field name. Tokenisation matters here.

questions.question: What does a location ending in -L mean?
questions.note: '-L' is nearly invisible to an embedding model — two characters carrying the whole meaning (loaner stock).

questions.question: What is the RestockMax table and what fields does it have?
How much commission is deducted from the rep when there is a discrepancy?
questions.note: Answer is 'Item Cost x 1.4'. Tests whether the right page is retrieved AND the number survives into the answer.

questions.question: hey so the thing where the rep gets money taken off, how much is it
questions.note: Same fact as q06 but phrased the way a real user types. This is the question query rewriting exists for — hybrid search will NOT fix it, because there is no exact term to match.

questions.question: what happens with the sticker thing after surgery
questions.note: 'sticker thing' vs 'stickersheet'. Vocabulary mismatch.

questions.question: Which endpoint powers the Backorders section of the Action Center?
questions.note: Answer: GET /ebi/backorders. Endpoint paths are pure lexical matches.

questions.question: How does a loaner shipping item get approved?
questions.note: Genuinely semantic — dense search should already handle this. Regression guard: your change must not break it.

questions.question: What is the difference between a BillingItem and a ShippingItem?
What prefix identifies a Cimplicity API key?
questions.note: Answer: the cim_ prefix. A short literal token — classic BM25 win.

questions.question: What does requireApikey do?
questions.note: Identifier lookup. Page 4 is a very short chunk (430 chars), which makes it hard for dense search to surface — another reason BM25's length normalisation helps.

questions.question: Where is the JWT payload cached and what is the TTL?
questions.note: Answer: Redis-backed, TTL aligned to JWT exp, capped at 60 min.

questions.question: What happens if disableSecurityCheck is true?
Do API keys respect the permission system?
questions.note: Answer: no — they bypass it and act as superuser. The doc phrases this as a warning, not as an answer to this question.

questions.question: When does the API return 403 versus 401?
questions.note: Status codes are numeric tokens — dense embeddings handle numbers poorly.

questions.question: How does user impersonation work and what permission does it need?
questions.note: Answer: impersonate header + user.impersonate permission.

questions.question: Where should refresh tokens be stored on web?
What does the wildcard * mean in a permission string?
questions.note: A single-character query term. Tokenisers routinely drop '*' entirely — worth checking in the trace's query_terms.

questions.question: which scopes does the frontend ask azure for
questions.note: Answer: openid, profile, email, offline_access.

questions.question: What is the pricing priority order for receipts?
questions.note: Answer: No Charge + Cap > Custom > Discount + Base Price. Order matters, so this is a good generation-failure probe — the right chunk can be retrieved and the ordering still garbled.

questions.question: Why are all the restock orders showing verificationStatus SKIPPED?
how do big inventory moves avoid slowing everything down
questions.note: Answer: transfers of 100+ items are scheduled off-peak.

questions.question: What are the two ERP systems and which module talks to each?
questions.note: Needs SAP (via EBI) and QAD from more than one page. A single top-1 chunk cannot answer it — this is where MMR's diversity should pay off.
